note:
⛔ SNG-512. THE DAMAGE-TYPE VOCABULARY AND ITS WARDS. CCode: '`damageType` on 26 crafts · `wardTypes` on ZERO · typed soak layers on ZERO. The 26 typed attacks are typed against nothing. `wrongType` can never be non-empty.' ⚠️ NOT DEAD — NEVER ALIVE.
⛔ NO ENGINE WORK NEEDED. `answers(l)` already matches a layer to a damage kind and a wrong-type layer already contributes nothing. Authoring the counterpart makes 26 existing values mean something the day it lands.
_derivedNotInvented: ⚠️ THE 13 TYPES BELOW ARE THE 13 ALREADY AUTHORED, not a new set. I grouped them and named what each is FOR; I did not add or rename one. ⛔ THREE ARE SINGLETONS AND MAY WANT MERGING — `grief` and `feeling` are both threnodist, and `judgement` appears once.

physical.what: Edge, weight, impact. The default when no type is named.
physical.wardedBy: armour, a held shield, a braced stance, worked stone
physical._note: ⛔ THE IMPLICIT TYPE. Most crafts carry none and resolve as this.

appetite.what: Want turned into a weapon — the Abyssal's own kind.
appetite.wardedBy: a vow held, a satisfied want, an honest ledger
appetite._note: ⛔ A WARD AGAINST APPETITE IS NOT ARMOUR — it is having nothing they can reach for.

shadow.what: Dark as a medium, not an absence.
shadow.wardedBy: held light, a lattice reading, anything that does not need eyes

decay.what: An ending hastened. ⛔ THE ANTI-HEALING TYPE.
decay.wardedBy: a tended vigil, consecrated ground, a mending held open
decay._note: ⛔ THIS IS THE ONE THE HEALING WORK NEEDS. `healing_intent.json` §5: a heal is reduced by ACTIVE ONGOING HARM, never by armour. A decay-typed condition a generic ward does not answer IS that mechanism.

living.what: Growth turned against — root, bloom, choking green.
living.wardedBy: cleared ground, salt, cut stone, a season's cold

abstraction.what: Pattern imposed on matter — a figure that cuts.
abstraction.wardedBy: ⛔ THE CONCRETE ITSELF. Thingcraft r3 'Denial' already does this in prose and is untyped.
abstraction._note: ⚠️ Body's Material school is the natural counter and none of it is typed.

feeling.wardedBy: a steadied mind, a held vow, contact with someone calm
feeling._absorbedGrief: ⛔ SNG-534. `grief` merged in. It was the ONLY damage type in the game that no ward answered — ⚠️ I flagged the merge as an Erik call in this very file and then left it open, and the which-check turned an open question into a failing gate.

truth.what: A fact that cannot be survived.
truth.wardedBy: ⚠️ almost nothing — that is the point. A prepared lie, or not being present

deception.wardedBy: the plain seeing, a verist's ground, a witness who was there

judgement.wardedBy: a clean conscience, or an unreachable one
judgement._erikCall: ⚠️ SINGLETON. Keep — it is the Seraphic signature and more will be authored.

temporal.wardedBy: an anchored hour, a kept count

vitality.what: ⛔ LIFE MOVED, NOT LIFE ENDED. Harm to one becomes healing for another — the same quantity, relocated.
vitality.wardedBy: a full vessel, a thing with nothing left to give, ⛔ BEING ALREADY DEAD, or a living ward that answers first
vitality._why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-24: 'heal is life added, the other side of it is harm. This skill steals vitality by TRANSFORMING HARM ON ONE INTO HEALING FOR ANOTHER. Seems like a common type we can use.' ⚠️ THE DEFINING PROPERTY IS CONSERVATION: every other type ENDS somewhere; this one ARRIVES. ⛔ IT IS NOT `decay` (an ending hastened — hastening is not taking) AND NOT `living` (growth turned against — life as a weapon, not life removed). The nearest neighbour is `temporal`, which is the same shape one axis over. ⚠️ CARRIERS: `draw_down` (ashwarden) and `consumed_wound` (abyssal) — two traditions reaching the same mechanic from opposite moral directions, which is what makes it a TYPE rather than one craft's quirk. ⛔ AGAINST THE UNDEAD IT IS EMPTY, NOT ABSORBED: a raised body runs on the ABSENCE of life, so there is nothing there to take (§48.5).

cold.what: ⛔ HEAT TAKEN OUT — not an ending hastened and not a wound, but warmth REMOVED until the body cannot work.
cold.wardedBy: fire, shelter, a living press of bodies, anything that MAKES heat rather than keeping it
cold._why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-24: 'you die from cold just as easily, and YOUR BODY GOES COLD WHEN YOU DIE.' ⚠️ IT IS NOT `decay` (an ending hastened) and not `physical` (edge, weight, impact) — it is REMOVAL, structurally `vitality`'s sibling: something taken rather than destroyed. ⛔ AND IT GIVES DEATH A SECOND AESTHETIC: the domain was entirely ROT, when cold is the other half of what a body does at the end. ⚠️ WARDED BY THINGS THAT MAKE HEAT, NOT THINGS THAT KEEP IT — armour is no answer, a fire is.

_wardRule:
⛔ A WARD NAMES WHAT IT ANSWERS. `mechanic.wardTypes: ["physical","light"]` means the layer contributes its soak against those kinds and NOTHING against others.
⚠️ A WARD THAT ANSWERS EVERYTHING IS A WARD WITH NO CHARACTER — and it is what all 65 ward-capable crafts currently are. ⛔ THE TRADITION'S IDENTITY IS IN WHAT IT CANNOT STOP.

_authoringGuide.1: A ward answers its own tradition's domain first — a Blazeborn's wall answers light, an Ashwarden's answers decay.
_authoringGuide.2: ⛔ MOST WARDS ANSWER `physical` PLUS ONE OR TWO OTHERS. Three is a lot; four is a capstone.
_authoringGuide.3: ⚠️ NAME THE GAP IN THE `cannot`. 'It will not stop a working that reaches for what you want' is a bound AND a type declaration.
_authoringGuide.4: A craft that answers nothing typed is `wardTypes: ["physical"]` — say so rather than leaving it null.

_deadTypesRemoved_20260829: ⛔ `light` and `precursor` removed. ⚠️ `light` migrated to `radiance`; `precursor` was ruled a METHOD not a type and carried by 7 crafts that dealt no damage. **Both had been listed here after their rulings, which is how a dead vocabulary keeps looking alive.**
